title: Ogoshi brothers (Lagos): sextortion ring that led to the death of Jordan DeMay
summary: Samuel and Samson Ogoshi, brothers from Lagos, Nigeria, used hacked social-media accounts to pose as young women, persuaded teenage boys and young men to send explicit images, then threatened to circulate them unless paid. Jordan DeMay, 17, of Marquette, Michigan, died by suicide in March 2022 after being asked for $1,000; prosecutors said the scheme targeted more than 100 victims. The brothers were extradited from Nigeria in August 2023, pleaded guilty in April 2024 to conspiracy to sexually exploit a minor, and in September 2024 a federal judge in Michigan sentenced each to 210 months in prison. A third man charged in the case was awaiting extradition; charges against him are allegations.
